start: Body, 'Progress photos' card, 'Add' (no photos yet); photo backup off

user_sees: Title 'Progress photos', subtitle 'Private. They stay on this phone.', empty state 'No photos yet'
must_not: A subtitle saying photos are backed up while backup is off

steps.action: Tap 'Add a photo'; sheet 'Add a progress photo' — 'Same spot, same light, every few weeks.'; tap 'Take a photo'
user_sees: The camera; after the shot the photo in the grid dated today
must_not: The photo saved twice; dated another day

user_sees: The viewer with 'Save to phone gallery', 'Change date', 'Delete photo'

start: Progress photos, 'Choose from gallery' with a WhatsApp copy (no date of its own)

user_sees: Sheet 'When was this photo taken?' — 'It came without a date of its own, so it shows today until you pick one.'
must_not: The photo silently filed under today with no question

user_sees: The photo placed on that day in the grid
must_not: The date changed on another photo

start: Progress photos with at least two photos

user_sees: 'Tap the first photo', then 'Now tap the second photo', with 'Cancel'
Screen 'Compare' with how far apart they are and 'Share before and after'
must_not: The two photos in the wrong order (newer as before)

user_sees: The phone share list with one before-and-after picture
must_not: Name or body weight on the picture

start: Progress photos, camera refused by the phone

user_sees: 'Camera not allowed. Allow the camera for MettleUp in your phone settings, or choose a photo from the gallery.' and 'Allow the camera in Settings'

steps.action: Tap 'Save to phone gallery' on a phone with no share list
user_sees: 'This phone has no share list, so the photo couldn’t be handed over.'

steps.action: Open Compare after one of the two photos was deleted
user_sees: 'Photos not found' — 'One of these photos was deleted. Go back and pick two again.'

start: Viewer open on a photo from 2 Oct

user_sees: Viewer shows 9 Oct; grid moves it
must_not: The photo duplicated on both days

user_sees: 'Delete this photo?' — 'From 9 Oct 2026. It is removed from the app for good.' with 'Delete'
The photo gone from the grid and from Compare
must_not: The file left behind in the backup or the grid

start: Member turns photo backup on in Settings, then opens Progress photos

user_sees: Subtitle 'Private. Your newest are in your phone’s backup too.'
must_not: Photos described as staying on the phone only while they are copied to the backup

steps.action: Member is in a gym; gym staff open the member in the panel
must_not: Any progress photo shown to the gym, trainers or gym mates
